title: Instincts set the direction of evolution

statements.text: Instincts, which are high-level algorithms, set the direction of evolution: an inherited drive repeatedly shapes behavior, that behavior favors some inherited traits over others, and over generations this can shape a lineage and help form new species.

sources.quote: Instincts (high-level algorithms) define the direction of evolution.
Over generations, the accumulated changes can shape a lineage and eventually contribute to the formation of new species.
